youtube_description:
AI Weekly Forecast: Google Job Cuts, Alexa's AI Capabilities & Walmart's Big Reveal At CES 2024

In this week's AI forecast video, we discuss major developments from within the realm of artificial technology. The video begins by addressing the job cuts at Google and how it impacts the Google Assistant and Pixel Phone divisions. We then delve into the highlights from CES 2024 where Amazon showcased Alexa's new generative AI capabilities and Walmart displayed their new generative AI search and replenishment features. The focus of discussions revolves around how AI is shaping the tech industry and altering our interaction with technology.

00:23 Google's Job Cuts and Its Impact
02:10 Highlights from CES 2024
02:43 Amazon's Alexa Showcases at CES
05:29 Walmart's New Generative AI Capabilities
07:17 Conclusion and Feedback Request
